correction: Non-markdown sync artifacts (.synced-from-core) escape **/*.md paths-ignore filters and trigger full image builds; ignore .agents/** and docs/** as trees, not by extension glob

ADRs must state context, decision, and consequences as facts only; process narration (who asked, who was consulted, how the author reached the conclusion) belongs in the PR description, not the ADR text — the rubric had no check for this and it slipped through review on core#137 (ADR-0050)

A gate that compares against git history must fail closed: only 'the base has no such path' may skip the comparison; a bad ref, an unreadable object or an output limit must fail. The file-system path and the git path must be the same root-relative path, and JSON member names must be checked for duplicates before JSON.parse drops them
